questions.question: Agency emails are going out. Happy with this text and list?
questions.body:
EMAIL 1 (exact text, example to The Reel Estate Studio)
Subject: overflow edits

Hi Marcus,

Saw that The Reel Estate Studio makes social video for estate agents in Surrey and South West London. When a few jobs land in the same week, do you ever need an extra editor?

I edit reels for a real estate firm in Goa, India. This one got about 7,000 likes: https://www.instagram.com/reel/DdYG1rVMhbx/
I can work white label, so it goes out under your name, and edits come back within 48 hours.

Want me to do a free test edit on one of your clips, so you can judge?

Sahil
Sahil Jamnani, video editor, Goa, India
sahiledits.com

P.S. If this isn't for you, just reply "no" and I won't email again.


FOLLOW-UP 1 (day 3, same thread)

Hi Marcus,

The usual worry with a new editor is missed deadlines or going quiet, so try me on one edit first, free. You send the raw clips and one past reel in your style. I match your fonts, captions and music, and since I'm in India the cut is often ready by your next morning. I never contact your clients or post the work.

Worth a try?

Sahil


FOLLOW-UP 2 (day 9, last)

Hi Marcus,

I'll stop here so I don't fill your inbox. If a busy week ever comes up, just reply here and I'll take a reel or two off your plate.

Sahil
